correctness.rationale: Closed neighborhood equals all base edges meeting the center edge. Empty and singleton traces force respectively two isolated vertices and a star forest; full trace forces at most two stars; explicit forbidden traces rule out a four-edge star or a three-edge star beside a second star. Witness centers realize exactly each listed family, labeled counts are disjoint and exhaustive, and dimension cutoffs follow from unused-isolate requirements. Independently enumerated 265023 supports in 9 graphs; tests corroborate, not replace the proof.

value.rationale: Complete exact counting of all shattered supports across every triangular graph is a natural structural invariant strictly finer than a VC upper bound, with support graphs forced into explicit star forests and sharp boundary n=8.
